mouth.name: Barrow Mouth
mouth.desc: A turf mound opens on a stone throat. A standing stone blocks the way north.

passage.name: Low Passage
passage.desc: You have to stoop. Grave goods crunch underfoot. The passage runs north.

cairn.name: The Cairn
cairn.desc: Stacked stones circle a bronze axe and a stoppered vial.

tomb.name: King's Tomb
tomb.desc: A stone bed holds a king who has not agreed to stay there.

barrow_riddle.desc: The standing stone asks: 'The more of me you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?'
barrow_riddle.success_msg: The stone sinks. The passage north is open.
barrow_riddle.hint: One word. Look back at the road you walked.
